fields.label: Names
fields.help: Your names as a couple, as they'll appear in the newspaper, e.g. Elif & Kerem.

fields.label: Cover photo
fields.help: A portrait-orientation photo of the couple works best.

elements.name: Kapak notu
elements.text:
WE'RE THRILLED
TO SHARE THE BEST
NEWS OF OUR LIVES
WITH YOU...

elements.name: Spot
elements.text:
DIFFERENT ROADS
LED US TO ONE STORY.

elements.name: Kart 1 not
elements.text:
And then our eyes met...
The rest is history...

elements.name: Kart 2 not
elements.text:
Our first step toward
exploring together...

elements.name: Spot
elements.text:
SMALL MOMENTS,
BIG HAPPINESS...
HERE ARE A FEW SHOTS
THAT MAKE US, US...

elements.name: Kenar notu
elements.text:
Same
city,
same
thrills,
same dreams
we share...

elements.name: Kartpostal yazısı
elements.text:
GOOD
PEOPLE
GOOD
PLACES
BEAUTIFUL
MEMORIES

elements.name: Damga yazısı
elements.text:
STILL EXPLORING
THE WORLD
WITH YOU...

elements.name: Teşekkür metni
elements.text:
THANK YOU WITH ALL OUR HEARTS
FOR BEING WITH US
ON OUR SPECIAL DAY,
FOR SHARING OUR JOY
AND FOR BECOMING
PART OF OUR STORY.

elements.name: El yazısı not
elements.text:
So lucky to have you...
On this beautiful day,
being with the people we love
is our greatest joy.

elements.name: Dilek
elements.text:
Wishing us
many more days together...

strings.tapToRead: You can also tap the cover to open it.
